== Notes ==
* This skill creates a [[Spirit of Fertile Season]].
* In PvE, this skill can be used before engaging groups of foes using armor-respecting damage (notably groups of [[elementalist]]s and elementalist [[boss]]es), as it provides a minor anti-[[spike]] effect.
